title: Asian and Pacific Islander students make up 5% of Blythedale School enrollment in 2025-26
text:
Blythedale School’s enrollment included seven Asian and Pacific Islander students for the 2025-26 school year, an increase of 75% compared to the prior year, according to the New York State Education Department .
Records indicate that the school enrolled a total of 141 students during the 2025-26 school year. Of these, Asian and Pacific Islander students comprised 5% of the population, making them the third least represented ethnic group at the school.
Located in the Mount Pleasant-Blythedale Union Free School District, Blythedale School is administered from a central office based in Valhalla.
It was the only school in the district to enroll Asian and Pacific Islander students at that time, accounting for seven students total.
New York ranks second in the country for K-12 public education spending , with current outlays reaching $30,012 per student. This figure is almost twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
